items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Him and Jelly Roll used to live together at one time, and they was very good friends -- and Buster played a lot like Jelly.

ctx.x: Buster originally was from Mississippi, I believe. What I learned is that Buster developed... Him and Jelly Roll used to live together at one time, and they was very good friends -- and Buster played a lot like Jelly. Buster drank, drank a lot of liquor. That's probably what helped put him away, really. But a nice man, a nice guy... Buster and I was real good friends. I really liked Buster. Better than anybody in that Kid Ory band, for that matter, you know.
Well, he didn't seem, from what I could gather, like he was involved in that New Orleans cliquey sort of thing. You know what I mean? Because he wasn't from there, I guess.
